manifestations.description: the plaintiffs complaints of sacral pain and back stiffness were genuine
persistent pain in the lower back after prolonged sitting or walking
lower back stiffness and right leg numbness on prolonged sitting
difficulty in ascending or descending stairs
pain on sleeping in a supine position or on the right side

treatments_received: MRI scan (performed at St Teresas Hospital on 11 March 2003)
X-rays (Yan Chai Hospital, Princess Margaret Hospital and others)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: could no longer enjoy her hobbies including jogging, swimming, cycling and hiking.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Her daughter took over most of the housework, which she could no longer perform except for some cooking.
She could not even do window-shopping with her daughter; when buying foodstuff from the market, her son and daughter had to help her out with the heavier items.
The pain and discomfort had caused her to become bad-tempered which had resulted in poor relationship with her family members.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life

losses.description: Her inability to have sexual intercourse led to her marriage break-up; she petitioned for divorce in May 2003 and a decree absolute was granted in July 2004.
Difficulty in ascending or descending stairs; inability to squat down; awkward gait/almost limping.
